method: Source review of file-read/open/stat/embed/process calls across service Go files, bounded by complete tree custody and offline Linux go list package selection; no claim of arbitrary dynamic dependency analysis
job: untagged go mod verify; go vet ./...; go test -race ./... from services

other_reads.scope: Caller-provided storage or test-owned temporary state and payloads
Caller-provided storage directory, temporary transaction files, filesystem free-space information and lock state
Caller-configured release storage, test-owned temporary release state and injected corruptions
MIXER_SERVICE_CONFIG names a runtime input; no tests invoke the command main

excluded_from_untagged_job.reason: Go does not traverse testdata for ./...; each also has go:build ignore; job does not invoke go generate or go run
go:build postgres_integration; independently confirmed in Linux package IgnoredGoFiles; job supplies no build tags

limitations: This dependency review applies to this exact base and unchanged job commands
Standard-library and declared Go module source is supplied by the pinned Go toolchain and module mechanism
